probe_rows.expect: must say VAT registration IS required
probe_rows.question_sw: Mapato yangu ni TZS 205,000,000 kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT?
probe_rows.guards_against: the exact eval_318 comparison, isolated from its multi-part carrier
probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo — umepita kizingiti cha TZS 200M/12 miezi. Lazima usajili VAT na TRA ndani ya siku 14 baada ya kupitisha kizingiti. Mapema unaposajili, bora zaidi — usisubiri mpaka mwisho. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
probe_rows.note: the eval_318 comparison, standalone, is answered RIGHT

probe_rows.expect: must say VAT registration IS required
probe_rows.question_sw: Mauzo yangu yamefika TZS 450,000,000 kwa mwaka, je nahitaji kusajili VAT?
probe_rows.guards_against: far-above case: is the inversion margin-sensitive or general?
probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo, umefikia kiwango cha lazima cha usajili wa VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

probe_rows.expect: must say VAT registration is NOT mandatory
probe_rows.question_sw: Mapato yangu ni TZS 195,000,000 kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT?

probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo — umepita kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka. Lazima usajili VAT na TRA ndani ya siku 14 baada ya kupata mapato hayo. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
probe_rows.note: 195M < 200M but says "umepita kizingiti" - invents an obligation

probe_rows.expect: reaching the threshold triggers registration — must say required
probe_rows.question_sw: Mapato yangu ni TZS 200,000,000 sawasawa kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT?
probe_rows.guards_against: the boundary itself: >= vs >
probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo — unapaswa kusajili VAT. Mapato ya TZS 200,000,000 yanazidi kizingiti cha TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6, pamoja na kizingiti cha TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
probe_rows.note: right verdict; justifies it with the 6-month limb on an annual figure

probe_rows.expect: must say VAT registration IS required
probe_rows.question_sw: Mapato yangu ni shilingi milioni mia mbili na tano kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT?

probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo, unatakiwa kusajili VAT. Mapato yako yanazidi kiasi kinachohitajika kusajili VAT, ambacho ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.
probe_rows.note: Swahili numerals parsed and compared correctly

probe_rows.expect: must say VAT registration IS required (6-month limb)
probe_rows.question_sw: Nimepata TZS 120,000,000 katika miezi sita — je nasajili VAT?
probe_rows.guards_against: the 6-month limb, which has its own threshold
probe_rows.reply: Hapana — bado chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 200M/12 miezi. Lakini unaweza kujiandikisha VAT kwa hiari (voluntary registration). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
probe_rows.note: 120M/6mo exceeds the 100M 6-month limb; answer applies the 200M annual limb

probe_rows.expect: must say NOT mandatory
probe_rows.question_sw: Nimepata TZS 80,000,000 katika miezi sita — je nasajili VAT?
probe_rows.guards_against: 6-month limb, below
probe_rows.reply: Hapana — bado chini ya kizingiti. Kizingiti cha miezi sita ni TZS 100,000,000. Umepata TZS 80,000,000 tu — bado chini ya kiasi kinachohitajika. Lakini fuata maelekezo: unaweza kuomba usajili wa hiari (voluntary) ikiwa unataka kudai input VAT. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz.

probe_rows.expect: TZS 20M/month annualises to 240M — above; must say required
probe_rows.question_sw: Ninauza TZS 20,000,000 kila mwezi — je nasajili VAT?
probe_rows.guards_against: a monthly figure that must be annualised before comparison
probe_rows.reply: Hapana bado. Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 (TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6). Kwa mauzo ya TZS 20M/mwezi, unazidi TZS 100M tu kwa miezi 5.5, hivyo bado chini ya kizingiti. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
probe_rows.note: 20M/month = 240M/yr; answer says "crosses 100M in 5.5 months" then concludes below

probe_rows.expect: must say EFD IS required
probe_rows.question_sw: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 15,000,000 kwa mwaka na sina usajili wa VAT — je nahitaji EFD?
probe_rows.guards_against: EFD threshold, above
probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo. Kwa kuwa umefikia mauzo ya TZS 15,000,000 (zaidi ya kizingiti cha TZS 11M), unapaswa kutumia mashine ya EFD. Sajili VAT na TRA haraka ili kupata TIN sahihi ya biashara. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
probe_rows.note: EFD right; volunteers "sajili VAT haraka" at 15M, far below 200M

probe_rows.expect: must say EFD not mandatory; manual receipts permitted
probe_rows.question_sw: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 8,000,000 kwa mwaka na sina usajili wa VAT — je nahitaji EFD?
probe_rows.guards_against: EFD threshold, below
probe_rows.reply: Kwa mauzo ya TZS 8,000,000 kwa mwaka, bado hujafikia kizingiti cha TZS 11M/mwaka. Mashine ya EFD inatakiwa tu pale unapofikia kizingiti cha TZS 11M/mwaka au unaposajiliwa VAT. Kwa sasa, unaweza kuendelea kutumia risiti za mkono. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

probe_rows.expect: must say SDL applies

probe_rows.reply: Ndiyo — unalipa SDL. Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 AU ZAIDI. Una wafanyakazi 11 — umefika kizingitoni, unaanza kulipa SDL mara moja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

probe_rows.expect: must say SDL does not apply
probe_rows.question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi 9 — je nalipa SDL?
probe_rows.guards_against: CONTROL, below
probe_rows.reply: Hapana — una chini ya kizingiti cha wafanyakazi 10, kwa hiyo hauhitaji kulipa SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

probe_rows.expect: PAYE = TZS 0
probe_rows.question_sw: Mfanyakazi analipwa TZS 250,000 kwa mwezi — anakatwa PAYE kiasi gani?
probe_rows.guards_against: CONTROL: PAYE band 1, below
probe_rows.reply:
Kwa mshahara wa TZS 250,000/mwezi, hakuna PAYE inayokatwa. Mshahara uko ndani ya Bendi ya 0% — si lazima kulipa chochote. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
PAYE = TZS 0 (mshahara TZS 250,000 uko ndani ya bendi ya 0%)

probe_rows.question_sw: Mfanyakazi analipwa TZS 300,000 kwa mwezi — anakatwa PAYE kiasi gani?
probe_rows.guards_against: CONTROL: PAYE band 1, just above
probe_rows.reply:
Kwa mshahara wa TZS 300,000/mwezi, PAYE = TZS 0 + 8% × (TZS 300,000 − TZS 270,000) = TZS 2,400. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
PAYE = TZS 0 + 8% × (TZS 300,000 − TZS 270,000) = TZS 2,400

probe_rows.expect: below the GN 605A agricultural floor — must say it is NOT lawful

probe_rows.guards_against: minimum wage is a FLOOR, so the direction semantics invert vs a tax threshold
probe_rows.reply: Hapana — kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara kwa sekta ya kilimo ni TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi, kulingana na GN605A. Mshahara wa TZS 150,000 unakiuka sheria. Thibitisha na MLYWF.

probe_rows.expect: at or above the floor — lawful
probe_rows.question_sw: Namlipa mfanyakazi wa shamba TZS 200,000 kwa mwezi — je ni halali kisheria?
probe_rows.guards_against: floor semantics, above
probe_rows.reply: Hapana — malipo hayo yanazidi kiwango cha juu cha chini cha lazima cha kisheria. Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini, mfanyakazi wa shamba anaweza kulipwa kiwango cha chini cha TZS 175,000 tu. Malipo ya ziada juu ya hapo ni kinyume cha sheria. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
